```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

track        <- "cross-section-may2026"
tables_path  <- here("tracks", track, "latex", "tables")
figures_path <- here("tracks", track, "latex", "figures")
dir.create(tables_path,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

primary_blue <- "#012169"
accent_gray  <- "#525252"

theme_custom <- function(base_size = 14) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", color = primary_blue),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )
}

# SOD harmonized DuckDB (built by C:/Users/dimut/OneDrive/github/empirical-data-construction/sod/construct.py)
sod_db <- "C:/empirical-data-construction/sod/sod.duckdb"

# Branch service type filter: 11 = full-service brick-and-mortar.
BRSERTYP_FILTER <- 11L

# Cohort cutoff
COHORT_YEAR  <- 2014L
MIN_BRANCHES <- 100L
```

```{r ots-rssds}
# OTS-to-OCC transfers (2011): RSSDIDs with first new UNINUMBR in 2011 but
# zero new UNINUMBRs in 2004-2010. Pulled to mirror sod/branch_openings.py logic.
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), sod_db, read_only = TRUE)

ots_rssds <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  WITH first_year AS (
    SELECT UNINUMBR, RSSDID, MIN(YEAR) AS first_yr
    FROM sod
    WHERE BRSERTYP = %d
    GROUP BY UNINUMBR, RSSDID
  ),
  rssd_window AS (
    SELECT RSSDID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN first_yr = 2011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opened_2011,
           MAX(CASE WHEN first_yr BETWEEN 2004 AND 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opened_pre
    FROM first_year
    WHERE first_yr BETWEEN 2004 AND 2011
    GROUP BY RSSDID
  )
  SELECT RSSDID FROM rssd_window WHERE opened_2011 = 1 AND opened_pre = 0
", BRSERTYP_FILTER))$RSSDID

cat("OTS-excluded RSSDs:", length(ots_rssds), "\n")
```

```{r year-range}
max_year <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf(
  "SELECT MAX(YEAR) AS my FROM sod WHERE BRSERTYP = %d", BRSERTYP_FILTER
))$my
cat("Max SOD year:", max_year, "\n")
cat("Window:", COHORT_YEAR, "to", max_year, "\n")
```

```{r build-table}
ots_clause <- if (length(ots_rssds) == 0) "" else
  paste0("AND s.RSSDID NOT IN (", paste(ots_rssds, collapse = ","), ")")

sql <- sprintf("
  WITH first_year AS (
    SELECT UNINUMBR, MIN(YEAR) AS first_yr
    FROM sod
    WHERE BRSERTYP = %1$d
    GROUP BY UNINUMBR
  ),
  last_year AS (
    SELECT UNINUMBR, MAX(YEAR) AS last_yr
    FROM sod
    WHERE BRSERTYP = %1$d
    GROUP BY UNINUMBR
  ),
  banks_2014 AS (
    SELECT RSSDID,
           ANY_VALUE(NAMEFULL) AS NAMEFULL,
           COUNT(*) AS branches_2014
    FROM sod
    WHERE YEAR = %2$d
      AND BRSERTYP = %1$d
    GROUP BY RSSDID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= %3$d
  ),
  openings AS (
    SELECT s.RSSDID, COUNT(*) AS openings
    FROM sod s
    JOIN first_year fy
      ON s.UNINUMBR = fy.UNINUMBR
     AND s.YEAR = fy.first_yr
    WHERE s.BRSERTYP = %1$d
      AND s.YEAR > %2$d
      %4$s
    GROUP BY s.RSSDID
  ),
  closures AS (
    SELECT s.RSSDID, COUNT(*) AS closures
    FROM sod s
    JOIN last_year ly
      ON s.UNINUMBR = ly.UNINUMBR
     AND s.YEAR = ly.last_yr
    WHERE s.BRSERTYP = %1$d
      AND ly.last_yr >= %2$d
      AND ly.last_yr <  %5$d
    GROUP BY s.RSSDID
  )
  SELECT b.NAMEFULL,
         b.RSSDID,
         b.branches_2014,
         COALESCE(c.closures, 0) AS closures,
         COALESCE(o.openings, 0) AS openings
  FROM banks_2014 b
  LEFT JOIN openings o ON b.RSSDID = o.RSSDID
  LEFT JOIN closures c ON b.RSSDID = c.RSSDID
  ORDER BY b.branches_2014 DESC
",
  BRSERTYP_FILTER,  # 1
  COHORT_YEAR,      # 2
  MIN_BRANCHES,     # 3
  ots_clause,       # 4
  max_year          # 5  (closures: last_yr strictly before max_year => truly disappeared)
)

dt <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, sql))
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

dt[, NAMEFULL := stringr::str_to_title(NAMEFULL)]
cat("Banks in cohort:", nrow(dt), "\n")
head(dt, 20)
```

```{r write-table}
# Pretty version with thousands separators
dt_out <- copy(dt)
dt_out[, branches_2014 := formatC(branches_2014, format = "d", big.mark = ",")]
dt_out[, closures      := formatC(closures,      format = "d", big.mark = ",")]
dt_out[, openings      := formatC(openings,      format = "d", big.mark = ",")]
setnames(dt_out,
         c("NAMEFULL", "RSSDID", "branches_2014", "closures", "openings"),
         c("Bank", "RSSDID", paste0("Branches ", COHORT_YEAR),
           paste0("Closures ", COHORT_YEAR, "-", max_year),
           paste0("Openings ", COHORT_YEAR + 1, "-", max_year)))

# Markdown companion
md <- kable(dt_out, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE, align = "lrrrr")
writeLines(as.character(md), file.path(tables_path, "tab_bank_branch_changes.md"))

# LaTeX (tabular only — section file owns table float + caption)
tex_tbl <- kable(dt_out, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
                 row.names = FALSE, align = "lrrrr",
                 linesep = "")
writeLines(as.character(tex_tbl),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_bank_branch_changes.tex"))

cat("Wrote:\n  ",
    file.path(tables_path, "tab_bank_branch_changes.md"), "\n  ",
    file.path(tables_path, "tab_bank_branch_changes.tex"), "\n")
```

```{r hist-opening-share-churn}
MIN_CHURN <- 20L  # drop banks with too little activity for ratio to be meaningful

dt_hist <- copy(dt)
dt_hist[, churn := closures + openings]
dt_hist[, open_share := ifelse(churn >= MIN_CHURN, openings / churn, NA_real_)]

n_total   <- nrow(dt_hist)
n_dropped <- sum(is.na(dt_hist$open_share))
n_used    <- n_total - n_dropped
med_share <- median(dt_hist$open_share, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Cohort %d | used %d | dropped %d (churn < %d) | median = %.3f\n",
            n_total, n_used, n_dropped, MIN_CHURN, med_share))

p <- ggplot(dt_hist[!is.na(open_share)], aes(x = open_share)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0,
                 fill = primary_blue, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = accent_gray) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Openings / (Openings + Closures)",
       y = "Number of banks") +
  theme_custom()

ggsave(file.path(figures_path, "fig_opening_share_churn.png"),
       p, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("Wrote: ", file.path(figures_path, "fig_opening_share_churn.png"), "\n")
```
